faq.title: How does the loan work?
faq.text: You deposit a collateral (e.g., XLM) and receive credit in STLT-BRL/USD. While the loan is active, keep the collateral above the minimum and track terms and interest. If the collateral falls, partial liquidation may occur.
faq.security_note: Security note: never share your keys. On-chain operations are irreversible.

education.title: Education and Alerts
education.item1: Use credit to invest responsibly; avoid refinancing higher interest debts.
education.item2: Avoid scams: Stellaro never asks for upfront payment to release credit.

intro.title: Protect yourself with Stellaro Insurance
intro.p1: Why have insurance? To increase your financial security against unforeseen events. Protect your balance, card, phone, crypto and even DeFi operations. Insurance does not replace safe practices: enable 2FA, use strong passwords and beware of unknown contacts.
intro.warning: Notice: insurance is complementary. Keep your personal security measures always active.
